exemplars.text: A country has the highest GDP per head in the world. What is this information most likely to suggest about the country? A It has the world’s biggest economy. B It has the world’s fastest economic growth rate. C It has the world’s greatest size of population. D It has the world’s highest standard of living.

A developing country starts to show increases in economic growth. What is most likely to occur? A a reduction in imports B a reduction in the number of doctors per capita C an increase in absolute poverty D an increase in incomes
What is a monetary policy measure? A increasing interest rates B increasing taxation C reducing the power of trade unions D selling state-owned enterprises

The Human Development Index (HDI) ranks human development in countries from 0 (lowest) to 1 (highest). What does the calculation of HDI not take into consideration? A estimate of life expectancy at birth B information on the number of years of schooling C regional inequalities of investments in human capital D standard of living linked to income per head
Calculate India’s economic growth rate in 2017. Identify two methods of protection. State why India is a mixed economy.

In low-income countries, fewer girls than boys become skilled design engineers. What might explain this situation? A Girls are only interested in low-wage jobs. B Girls do not favour heavy manual work. C Girls have fewer opportunities to complete higher education. D It costs more for girls to be trained as design engineers.
